title: Accessible means of egress elevators.
officialText:
Standby power shall be provided for elevators that are part of an accessible
means of egress in accordance with Section 1007.4.
previewText:
Standby power shall be provided for elevators that are part of an accessible
means of egress in accordance with Section 1007.4.
